cohort: 680 primiparas who delivered between December 2011 and December 2013 from Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital, Capital Medical University.
finding: New-pattern obstetrical nursing significantly reduced both the cesarean delivery rate (21.8% vs 32.9%, P<0.05) and the incidence rate of perioperative complications compared to traditional nursing.
mod_finding: New-pattern obstetrical nursing significantly reduced the cesarean delivery rate from 32.9% in the control group to 21.8% in the observation group.
